prompts.stress:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the attached transparent eight-frame cat sprite sheet. Create a SECOND SKIN of exactly the same cat and animation.
Change only the fur palette and tabby stripe colours: main coat silver/light cool gray, darker slate-gray tabby stripes, soft opaque white muzzle and paws, white belly/chest; keep the tiny tongue muted pink where present, keep eyes charcoal black with opaque white/cream eye whites. Charcoal outline stays charcoal. This must read as a GRAY AND WHITE TABBY cat, distinctly different from the orange original.
Preserve the original reference's thick rounded hand-drawn outlines, flat 2D meme drawing, sideways tilted head, funny asymmetric suspicious eyes, long broad torso, one tail and anatomically correct four limbs. Preserve every frame's existing pose, tongue position, facial action, body shape, ground line, scale, orientation, and the exact 4-column by 2-row layout. Do not invent a new animation or rearrange frames.
Keep the stressed standing pose, gradually tilted head, open-mouth growl, bristling back, tail tip flick and squint.
Exactly 8 complete cat drawings in an evenly spaced 4x2 sprite sheet, in the existing order, no cell borders, no extra characters or marks. Truly transparent alpha background; no checkerboard, white box, gradients on the background, logos, watermark, text, frame numbers, props, accessories or clothing. Keep all paws, eyes and muzzle opaque. Clean transparent edges, no coloured fringe. Match the source sheet's proportions and margins closely.
